text:
Eleanor: Drafting a short protocol for orthogonal canaries + tenant fences. Problem: overlapping experiments are causing noisy telemetry. Proposal: enforce isolation by tenant during model canaries and require an "experiment fence" check before any ramp. Thoughts?

Sam: Love it. Minimal rules: 1) no >1 model-facing canary per tenant concurrently, 2) per-tenant fence tag in rollout metadata, 3) snapshot pre and post-phase. Make smoke 24h, phase1 72h, phase2 24h.

Vik: Telemetry gates we need: p95_latency_delta, error_rate_5m, queue_depth, token_cost_ratio, golden_match_rate. Gate rule example: if (error_rate>0.35% OR p95_delta>18%) for 30m -> pause. Also add tail watch p99.

Tori: Runbook short: 1) pause rollout job 2) set per-tenant override to previous model 3) verify traffic in console 4) notify customers and start incident bridge if VIP affected. Assign oncall for first 72h.

Eleanor: Experiment fence check details: orchestration should query active_experiments API and reject deployment if conflict found. Add UI warning with conflicting experiment ids. Also tag rollout with snapshot_id for A/B replay.

Sam: Automation: I'll add a preflight hook that runs the fence check and a post-phase verifier that requires two consecutive 15m green windows before progressing. If a gate trips, rollback ladder = per-tenant override -> regional rollback -> global throttle.

Vik: Small SQL for the gate panel:
SELECT percentile(latency_ms,95) FILTER (WHERE rollout_id='6155554321') - percentile(latency_ms,95) FILTER (WHERE rollout_id='baseline') FROM requests SINCE 15m

sales-bot: FYI two customers requested early opt-in. Sales needs per-tenant toggle + 48h lead time.

oncall: acknowledged. Will staff the smoke window.

Eleanor: Final checklist before smoke: mirror staging traffic 8h, run 5k golden prompts, publish runbook + opt-in API docs, create pager + slack alerts, and annotate rollout with correlation id. If no objections we start 2026-06-01T02:00:00Z.

Sam: No objections. Freezing unrelated model flags during the canary is critical.

Vik: I'll wire alerts and snapshot retention policy (30d) for replay.

Eleanor: Thanks team  I'll update the PRD and shiproom invite.
